event: 2026 ILCA SENIOR EUROPEAN CHAMPIONSHIPS & OPEN EUROPEAN TROPHY
procedural_matters: CRO 212013 was represented by Tonci Stipanovic.
The Race Committee was represented by Francisco Sg Jauregui.
facts: The race committee displayed Black flag as the preparatory signal for race F1 of the ILCA 7 Gold Fleet, around 13:00 on 20.05.2026.
The race committee posted the identified boats scored BFD on board located at the stern of Race Committee Vessel and on the event Telegram group.
The information that CRO 212013 was scored BDF was posted on the Event telegram group at 13:15 on 20.05.2026.
After finishing CRO 212013 learned about BFD in race F1 from his coach and saw his number on the board.
After coming back ashore CRO 212013 did not submit a scoring inquiry. He packed the boat and went home.
CRO 212013 delivered the request of redress at 11:11 on 21.05.2026.
The protest time limit for the ILCA 7 Gold Fleet was 18:00 on 20.05.2026.
conclusions: CRO 212013 failed to deliver the request for redress within the protest time limit, as required by RRS 61.2(b)(1). There was no good reason for the International Jury to extend the time limit. Therefore, the request for redress is invalid under RRS 61.3.
decision: The request for redress is invalid, the hearing is closed under RRS 63.4(a)(1).
